notes.title: Party Friends first birthday!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

It's been a year since Party Friends was released, and what a year it has been! First of all, the most fun we’ve had was watching the YouTube videos you guys made. We loved the content you created—it’s a joy to watch you play our game and have fun with it. We also had a lot of fun creating the game, from designing and prototyping to iterating, testing, and polishing gameplay and graphics. Now, we wanted to share some 'behind-the-scenes' moments from the development of Party Friends.

[i]Here's a  screenshot of a prototype of Sandwich Pirates.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776873/e3a14eeef5fa5645994f20a79ccd50e39c256599.png[/img]


[i]Here's a prototype of Seashell Collector. At first, there wasn’t any trash to collect—just seashells—but we wanted to add a side quest and strategy element for players, so we added it quite late in development.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776873/66f54c4941ddf35048b49d6031189235a58a2bd3.gif[/img]

[i]Hack and Chop was one of our team's favorite games. Here’s a sneak peek of how it looked at the end of the prototyping cycle.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776873/671ff9a64e393c572551b995fdb8f3c92284277e.gif[/img]



Thanks for enjoying our game! Make sure to check out our other local multiplayer games!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471130/Casual_Sport_Series_Tennis/

notes.title: House Fighters: Total Mess - a new upcoming project from Revulo Games!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956695/14d5478821b937dbc615c808b80239724affdf0a.png[/img]

[b]House Fighters: Total Mess [/b]is a playful arcade dogfighting game. Hop into a toy plane, zip through cozy rooms, and turn everyday objects into thrilling battlegrounds. No complicated controls, just pure, lighthearted aerial chaos. Weave between bookshelves, dodge towering lamps, and outmaneuver tiny enemies in fast-paced, feel-good combat.


[list]
[*]Weave, and strike in high-speed dogfights. Use rockets, bombs, and even household items to outmaneuver your toy-sized foes.
[*]Customize your fighter with playful stickers, wacky weapons, and unexpected upgrades. Experiment and find the perfect loadout for every mission.
[*]Chase, dodge, and loop through playful missions where every room holds a new challenge. Sneak past towering obstacles, weave through tight spaces, and take on clever little foes in fast, lighthearted dogfights.
[/list]
